reason: author correction of two commits, trees unchanged
method: Every commit that descends from the corrected commits was recreated parents first with the same tree, message, author, committer and dates, and signed again; only the parents changed (and the identity of the two corrected commits).
verification: For every pair: same tree, byte-identical message, same author and committer dates, the same number of parents, and parents mapped through this table.
For every rewritten ref: the new tip has the same tree as the old tip.
Every new commit carries a good signature from the owner's key and no commit in the new ranges names the previous identity.
Rebind: in each file listed under rebind.files, applying rebind.digestRounds in reverse and then new->old commit SHAs restores bytes whose sha256 is preRebindSha256.

Appended rebinds (rebind.appends, one per merged branch): in each file listed under an append's files, putting each recorded original token back at its byte offset restores bytes whose sha256 is preRebindSha256; every commit pair agrees with this table (by prefix) and every digest pair follows that append's digestRounds.
